d: Kareena Kapoor Khan faced a major controversy after wearing a historic Ayat-ul-Kursi pendant from Saif Ali Khan’s Bhopal royal family heritage during Diwali celebrations. The silver and emerald jewelry piece featuring the sacred Quranic verse from Surah Al-Baqarah was showcased by stylist Rhea Kapoor, prompting Madhya Pradesh Congress leader Abbas Hafeez to send a legal notice alleging disrespect to Islamic sentiments by using the holy verse as a fashion accessory.
